reviews.comment: I took Dr. Li over the summer for Comms 203, but she was an easy grader. She didn't make the class harder than it had to be, and she gives a lot of feedback, which is super helpful. I definitely recommend!
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: She is so sweet and has fun activities in class, but she lectures by reading from the slide or the textbook, and it's hard to pay attention, but the class itself is easy, and she's an easy grader.

Professor Li was good but typically read straight from the textbook during lectures. Attendance was mandatory (if you missed more than 3 classes your grade would drop a letter grade) and exams were taken as a group. Exams were very confusing and tried to trick you. This was my hardest class of the semester and I don't think it should've been.
